items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You think a lot later, of course, than Doceman.

ctx.x: Ori? Yes. Yeah, Ori always did use the slide, since I started with Ori.
You think a lot later, of course, than Doceman.

Yeah, Ori always used the slide, since I knew him. I played with him. Well, slide was favorite then. It was all the vowels that was going out of style. Because Frank, he was never much on a slide. Well, Ori had a pretty good year for music. That's why Joe liked him so much. Catch on pretty quick. No, pretty quick. Also, Johnny. Johnny would catch on, make things, various from a violin like that, like piano and things like that. Johnny would catch it. He'd just bust out a laugh when he'd make it. And so, I went…
